Summary: Mid-market CCaaS vendor building a real-time agent assist layer for large enterprise customers. Primary interest: streaming suggestions (token streaming to UI), deterministic low-latency SLOs during spikes, safe tool-calling (CRM patch/update), and nightly ticket summarization for QA.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-22: Intro discovery (Ethan) — high-level product fit, they want same API across hosted/dedicated/private. Quote: "Need suggestions in the agent UI under 200ms p95 — anything slower hurts throughput."
- 2026-01-29: Architecture deep-dive w/ SE (Maya) — reviewed network topology, KV caching idea, initial baseline traffic profiles (400 concurrent agents typical, 2k peak during promos). Fireflies: ff-20260129-1220.

Technical requirements & notes:
- Workload: streaming agent suggestions (incremental tokens), inline tool-calls to CRM (PATCH/POST), short ticket summarization jobs at off-peak windows.
- Latency SLO goal: end-to-end suggestion appearance <= 200ms p95; ideal <150ms. Token streaming must be visible to agent UI in <80ms after token generation.
- Throughput: baseline 400 concurrent agents, burst target 2,000 concurrent sessions for marketing spikes. Must sustain for 30–45 minute windows.
- Reliability: need graceful degradation path (fallback to lighter model or cached prompts) with no silent failures.
- Guardrails: strict hallucination reduction, explicit denylist for PII/tooling (no direct SSN edits), audit log per token and tool-call events, automatic redaction hooks before logs leave cluster.
- Model preferences: open model family preferred, but willing to use Redwood-verified quantized variants if latency/cost tradeoff proven. Need recommendations from Redwood Optimize for batching/quantization per workload.
- Deployment: interested in Dedicated for predictable latency; Private if legal requires EU-only residency. VPC peering and egress control required.

Procurement/Commercial:
- Estimated ARR band: $150k–$400k; buying committee: Head of Product, SecOps, VP Ops.
- Procurement timeline: aiming for March 2026 close (depends on POC).
